text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
translation_en: Harmalah ibn Yahya narrated it to me. Ibn Wahb informed us. Yunus informed me, from Ibn Shihab, with this chain, with the same meaning.

title: باب اسْتِحْبَابِ بَعْثِ الْهَدْىِ إِلَى الْحَرَمِ لِمَنْ لاَ يُرِيدُ الذَّهَابَ بِنَفْسِهِ وَاسْتِحْبَابِ تَقْلِيدِهِ وَفَتْلِ الْقَلاَئِدِ وَأَنَّ بَاعِثَهُ لاَ يَصِيرُ مُحْرِمًا وَلاَ يَحْرُمُ عَلَيْهِ شيء بِذَلِكَ
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ح. وَحَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، وَخَلَفُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالُوا أَخْبَرَنَا حَمَّادُ، بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَأَنِّي أَنْظُرُ إِلَىَّ أَفْتِلُ قَلاَئِدَ هَدْىِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِنَحْوِهِ ‏.‏
translation_en: Sa'id ibn Mansur and Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to us. They said: Sufyan narrated to us, from al-Zuhri, from Urwah, from Aisha, from the Prophet (peace be upon him). H; and Sa'id ibn Mansur, Khalaf ibn Hisham, and Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us. They said: Hammad ibn Zayd informed us, from Hisham ibn Urwah, from his father, from Aisha. She said: It is as though I can see myself twisting the garlands of the sacrificial animals of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him), with the same meaning.
translation_de: Sa'id ibn Mansur and Zuhayr ibn Harb überlieferte uns. They said: Sufyan überlieferte uns, from al-Zuhri, from Urwah, from Aisha, from der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm). H; and Sa'id ibn Mansur, Khalaf ibn Hisham, and Qutaybah ibn Sa'id überlieferte uns. They said: Hammad ibn Zayd berichtete uns, from Hisham ibn Urwah, from his father, from Aisha. Sie sagte: It is as though I can see myself twisting the garlands of the Opfertiere of der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm), with the same meaning. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

title: باب اسْتِحْبَابِ بَعْثِ الْهَدْىِ إِلَى الْحَرَمِ لِمَنْ لاَ يُرِيدُ الذَّهَابَ بِنَفْسِهِ وَاسْتِحْبَابِ تَقْلِيدِهِ وَفَتْلِ الْقَلاَئِدِ وَأَنَّ بَاعِثَهُ لاَ يَصِيرُ مُحْرِمًا وَلاَ يَحْرُمُ عَلَيْهِ شيء بِذَلِكَ
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَائِشَةَ، تَقُولُ كُنْتُ أَفْتِلُ قَلاَئِدَ هَدْىِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِيَدَىَّ هَاتَيْنِ ثُمَّ لاَ يَعْتَزِلُ شَيْئًا وَلاَ يَتْرُكُهُ.
translation_en: Sa'id ibn Mansur narrated to us. Sufyan narrated to us, from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Qasim, from his father, who said: I heard Aisha say: I used these two hands of mine to twist the garlands of the sacrificial animals of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him), then he did not abstain from anything and did not leave it.
translation_de: Sa'id ibn Mansur überlieferte uns. Sufyan überlieferte uns, from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Qasim, from his father, who said: I heard Aisha say: I used these two hands of mine to twist the garlands of the Opfertiere of der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm), then he did not abstain from anything and did not leave it. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

title: باب اسْتِحْبَابِ بَعْثِ الْهَدْىِ إِلَى الْحَرَمِ لِمَنْ لاَ يُرِيدُ الذَّهَابَ بِنَفْسِهِ وَاسْتِحْبَابِ تَقْلِيدِهِ وَفَتْلِ الْقَلاَئِدِ وَأَنَّ بَاعِثَهُ لاَ يَصِيرُ مُحْرِمًا وَلاَ يَحْرُمُ عَلَيْهِ شيء بِذَلِكَ
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ بْنِ قَعْنَبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَفْلَحُ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ فَتَلْتُ قَلاَئِدَ بُدْنِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِيَدَىَّ ثُمَّ أَشْعَرَهَا وَقَلَّدَهَا ثُمَّ بَعَثَ بِهَا إِلَى الْبَيْتِ وَأَقَامَ بِالْمَدِينَةِ فَمَا حَرُمَ عَلَيْهِ شَىْءٌ كَانَ لَهُ حِلاًّ ‏.‏
translation_en: Abd Allah ibn Maslamah ibn Qa'nab narrated to us. Aflah narrated to us, from al-Qasim, from Aisha. She said: I twisted the garlands of the sacrificial animals of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) with these two hands of mine. Then he marked them and garlanded them, sent them toward the House, and remained in Madinah. Nothing that had been lawful for him became forbidden to him.
translation_de: Abd Allah ibn Maslamah ibn Qa'nab überlieferte uns. Aflah überlieferte uns, from al-Qasim, from Aisha. Sie sagte: I twisted the garlands of the Opfertiere of der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) with these two hands of mine. Then he marked them and garlanded them, sent them toward the Haus, and remained in Medina. Nothing that had been erlaubt for him became forbidden to him. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

title: باب اسْتِحْبَابِ بَعْثِ الْهَدْىِ إِلَى الْحَرَمِ لِمَنْ لاَ يُرِيدُ الذَّهَابَ بِنَفْسِهِ وَاسْتِحْبَابِ تَقْلِيدِهِ وَفَتْلِ الْقَلاَئِدِ وَأَنَّ بَاعِثَهُ لاَ يَصِيرُ مُحْرِمًا وَلاَ يَحْرُمُ عَلَيْهِ شيء بِذَلِكَ
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ السَّعْدِيُّ، وَيَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الدَّوْرَقِيُّ، قَالَ ابْنُ حُجْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ، وَأَبِي، قِلاَبَةَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَبْعَثُ بِالْهَدْىِ أَفْتِلُ قَلاَئِدَهَا بِيَدَىَّ ثُمَّ لاَ يُمْسِكُ عَنْ شَىْءٍ لاَ يُمْسِكُ عَنْهُ الْحَلاَلُ ‏.‏
translation_en: Ali ibn Hujr al-Sa'di and Ya'qub ibn Ibrahim al-Dawraqi narrated to us. Ibn Hujr said: Ismail ibn Ibrahim narrated to us, from Ayyub, from al-Qasim and Abu Qilabah, from Aisha. She said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) used to send sacrificial animals. I would twist their garlands with these two hands of mine, then he would not abstain from anything from which a person who is lawful does not abstain.
translation_de: Ali ibn Hujr al-Sa'di and Ya'qub ibn Ibrahim al-Dawraqi überlieferte uns. Ibn Hujr said: Ismail ibn Ibrahim überlieferte uns, from Ayyub, from al-Qasim and Abu Qilabah, from Aisha. Sie sagte: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) used to send Opfertiere. I would twist their garlands with these two hands of mine, then he would not abstain from anything from which a person who is erlaubt does not abstain. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

title: باب اسْتِحْبَابِ بَعْثِ الْهَدْىِ إِلَى الْحَرَمِ لِمَنْ لاَ يُرِيدُ الذَّهَابَ بِنَفْسِهِ وَاسْتِحْبَابِ تَقْلِيدِهِ وَفَتْلِ الْقَلاَئِدِ وَأَنَّ بَاعِثَهُ لاَ يَصِيرُ مُحْرِمًا وَلاَ يَحْرُمُ عَلَيْهِ شيء بِذَلِكَ
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا حُسَيْنُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عَوْنٍ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنْ أُمِّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، قَالَتْ أَنَا فَتَلْتُ، تِلْكَ الْقَلاَئِدَ مِنْ عِهْنٍ كَانَ عِنْدَنَا فَأَصْبَحَ فِينَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَلاَلاً يَأْتِي مَا يَأْتِي الْحَلاَلُ مِنْ أَهْلِهِ أَوْ يَأْتِي مَا يَأْتِي الرَّجُلُ مِنْ أَهْلِهِ ‏.‏
translation_en: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated to us. Husayn ibn al-Hasan narrated to us. Ibn Awn narrated to us, from al-Qasim, from the Mother of the Believers. She said: I twisted those garlands from wool that we had. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) remained among us in a state of lawfulness, doing what a lawful man does with his family.
translation_de: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna überlieferte uns. Husayn ibn al-Hasan überlieferte uns. Ibn Awn überlieferte uns, from al-Qasim, from the Mother of the Believers. Sie sagte: I twisted those garlands from wool that we had. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) remained among us in a state of erlaubtness, doing what a erlaubt man does with his family. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ لَقَدْ رَأَيْتُنِي أَفْتِلُ الْقَلاَئِدَ لِهَدْىِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنَ الْغَنَمِ فَيَبْعَثُ بِهِ ثُمَّ يُقِيمُ فِينَا حَلاَلاً ‏.‏
translation_en: Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to us. Jarir narrated to us, from Mansur, from Ibrahim, from al-Aswad, from Aisha. She said: I saw myself twisting the garlands for the sacrificial animals of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) from sheep. He would send them, then remain among us in a state of lawfulness.
translation_de: Zuhayr ibn Harb überlieferte uns. Jarir überlieferte uns, from Mansur, from Ibrahim, from al-Aswad, from Aisha. Sie sagte: I saw myself twisting the garlands for the Opfertiere of der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) from Schafe. He would send them, then remain among us in a state of erlaubtness. text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جُحَادَةَ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كُنَّا نُقَلِّدُ الشَّاءَ فَنُرْسِلُ بِهَا وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَلاَلٌ لَمْ يَحْرُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْهُ شَىْءٌ ‏.‏

text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، عَنْ عَمْرَةَ، بِنْتِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ أَنَّهَا أَخْبَرَتْهُ أَنَّ ابْنَ زِيَادٍ كَتَبَ إِلَى عَائِشَةَ أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ مَنْ أَهْدَى هَدْيًا حَرُمَ عَلَيْهِ مَا يَحْرُمُ عَلَى الْحَاجِّ حَتَّى يُنْحَرَ الْهَدْىُ وَقَدْ بَعَثْتُ بِهَدْيِي فَاكْتُبِي إِلَىَّ بِأَمْرِكِ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ عَمْرَةُ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ لَيْسَ كَمَا قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ أَنَا فَتَلْتُ قَلاَئِدَ هَدْىِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِيَدَىَّ ثُمَّ قَلَّدَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِيَدِهِ ثُمَّ بَعَثَ بِهَا مَعَ أَبِي فَلَمْ يَحْرُمْ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم شَىْءٌ أَحَلَّهُ اللَّهُ لَهُ حَتَّى نُحِرَ الْهَدْىُ ‏.‏
translation_en: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us. He said: I read to Malik, from Abd Allah ibn Abi Bakr, from Amrah bint Abd al-Rahman, who informed him that Ibn Ziyad wrote to Aisha that Ibn Abbas had said: Whoever sends a sacrificial animal, what is forbidden to the pilgrim is forbidden to him until the sacrifice is slaughtered. I have sent my sacrifice, so write to me with your ruling. Amrah said that Aisha said: It is not as Ibn Abbas said. I twisted the garlands of the sacrificial animals of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) with my own hands, then the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) garlanded them with his own hand and sent them with Abu. Nothing that Allah had made lawful for the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) became forbidden to him until the sacrifice was slaughtered.

Er sagte: I read to Malik, from Abd Allah ibn Abi Bakr, from Amrah bint Abd al-Rahman, who informed him that Ibn Ziyad wrote to Aisha that Ibn Abbas had said: Whoever sends a Opfertier, what is forbidden to the Pilger is forbidden to him until the Opfer is slaughtered. I twisted the garlands of the Opfertiere of der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) with my own hands, then der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) garlanded them with his own hand and sent them with Abu. Nothing that Allah had made erlaubt for der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) became forbidden to him until the Opfer was slaughtered. title: باب جَوَازِ رُكُوبِ الْبَدَنَةِ الْمُهْدَاةِ لِمَنِ احْتَاجَ إِلَيْهَا ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَأَى رَجُلاً يَسُوقُ بَدَنَةً فَقَالَ ‏"‏ ارْكَبْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّهَا بَدَنَةٌ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ ارْكَبْهَا وَيْلَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فِي الثَّانِيَةِ أَوْ فِي الثَّالِثَةِ ‏.‏
translation_en: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us. He said: I read to Malik, from Abu al-Zinad, from al-Araj, from Abu Hurayra, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) saw a man leading a sacrificial camel and said: Ride it. text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، قَالَ هَذَا مَا حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرَ أَحَادِيثَ مِنْهَا وَقَالَ بَيْنَمَا رَجُلٌ يَسُوقُ بَدَنَةً مُقَلَّدَةً قَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ وَيْلَكَ ارْكَبْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ بَدَنَةٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَيْلَكَ ارْكَبْهَا وَيْلَكَ ارْكَبْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Muhammad ibn Rafi narrated to us. Abd al-Razzaq narrated to us. Ma'mar narrated to us, from Hammam ibn Munabbih, who said: This is what Abu Hurayra narrated to us, from Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him). He mentioned hadiths, including this: While a man was leading a garlanded sacrificial camel, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said to him: Woe to you, ride it. He said: It is a sacrificial camel, Messenger of Allah. He said: Woe to you, ride it; woe to you, ride it.

Ma'mar überlieferte uns, from Hammam ibn Munabbih, who said: This is what Abu Hurayra überlieferte uns, from Muhammad, der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm). He mentioned hadiths, including this: While a man was leading a garlanded Opferkamel, der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) said to him: Woe to you, ride it. title: باب جَوَازِ رُكُوبِ الْبَدَنَةِ الْمُهْدَاةِ لِمَنِ احْتَاجَ إِلَيْهَا ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَسُرَيْجُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا حُمَيْدٌ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ وَأَظُنُّنِي قَدْ سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْ، أَنَسٍ ح. وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - أَخْبَرَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ الْبُنَانِيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ مَرَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِرَجُلٍ يَسُوقُ بَدَنَةً فَقَالَ ‏"‏ ارْكَبْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ إِنَّهَا بَدَنَةٌ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ ارْكَبْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ مَرَّتَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلاَثًا ‏.‏
translation_en: Amr al-Naqid and Surayj ibn Yunus narrated to me. They said: Hushaym narrated to us. Humayd informed us, from Thabit, from Anas. I think I heard it from Anas. H; and Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us, and this is his wording. Hushaym informed us, from Humayd, from Thabit al-Bunani, from Anas. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) passed by a man leading a sacrificial camel and said: Ride it. The man said: It is a sacrificial camel. He said: Ride it, two or three times.
translation_de: Amr al-Naqid and Surayj ibn Yunus überlieferte mir. They said: Hushaym überlieferte uns. Humayd berichtete uns, from Thabit, from Anas. I think I heard it from Anas. H; and Yahya ibn Yahya überlieferte uns, and this is his wording. Hushaym berichtete uns, from Humayd, from Thabit al-Bunani, from Anas. Er sagte: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) passed by a man leading a Opferkamel and said: Ride it. The man said: It is a Opferkamel. Er sagte: Ride it, two or three times. title: باب جَوَازِ رُكُوبِ الْبَدَنَةِ الْمُهْدَاةِ لِمَنِ احْتَاجَ إِلَيْهَا ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ مِسْعَرٍ، عَنْ بُكَيْرِ بْنِ الأَخْنَسِ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ مُرَّ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِبَدَنَةٍ أَوْ هَدِيَّةٍ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ ارْكَبْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ إِنَّهَا بَدَنَةٌ أَوْ هَدِيَّةٌ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ وَإِنْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us. Waki narrated to us, from Misar, from Bukayr ibn al-Akhnas, from Anas. He said: I heard him say: A sacrificial camel or an offering was led past the Prophet (peace be upon him), and he said: Ride it. The man said: It is a sacrificial camel or an offering. He said: Even so.
translation_de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah überlieferte uns. Waki überlieferte uns, from Misar, from Bukayr ibn al-Akhnas, from Anas. Er sagte: I heard him say: A Opferkamel or an Opfergabe was led past der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm), and he said: Ride it. The man said: It is a Opferkamel or an Opfergabe. Er sagte: Even so. translation_en: Abu Kurayb narrated to us. Ibn Bishr narrated to us, from Misar. Bukayr ibn al-Akhnas narrated to me. He said: I heard Anas say: A sacrificial camel was led past the Prophet (peace be upon him). He mentioned the same as this.
translation_de: Abu Kurayb überlieferte uns. Ibn Bishr überlieferte uns, from Misar. Bukayr ibn al-Akhnas überlieferte mir. Er sagte: I heard Anas say: A Opferkamel was led past der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm). He mentioned the same as this. title: باب جَوَازِ رُكُوبِ الْبَدَنَةِ الْمُهْدَاةِ لِمَنِ احْتَاجَ إِلَيْهَا ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، سُئِلَ عَنْ رُكُوبِ الْهَدْىِ، فَقَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ ارْكَبْهَا بِالْمَعْرُوفِ إِذَا أُلْجِئْتَ إِلَيْهَا حَتَّى تَجِدَ ظَهْرًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Muhammad ibn Hatim narrated to me. Yahya ibn Sa'id narrated to us, from Ibn Jurayj. Abu al-Zubayr informed me. He said: I heard Jabir ibn Abd Allah being asked about riding a sacrificial animal. He said: I heard the Prophet (peace be upon him) say: Ride it properly when you are forced to do so, until you find another mount.
translation_de: Muhammad ibn Hatim überlieferte mir. Yahya ibn Sa'id überlieferte uns, from Ibn Jurayj. Abu al-Zubayr berichtete mir. Er sagte: I heard Jabir ibn Abd Allah being asked about riding a Opfertier. Er sagte: I heard der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm) say: Ride it properly when you are forced to do so, until you find another mount. title: باب جَوَازِ رُكُوبِ الْبَدَنَةِ الْمُهْدَاةِ لِمَنِ احْتَاجَ إِلَيْهَا ‏‏

translation_de: Salamah ibn Shabib überlieferte mir. al-Hasan ibn Ayan überlieferte uns. Maqil überlieferte uns, from Abu al-Zubayr, who said: I asked Jabir about riding a Opfertier. title: باب مَا يُفْعَلُ بِالْهَدْىِ إِذَا عَطِبَ فِي الطَّرِيقِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي التَّيَّاحِ الضُّبَعِيِّ، حَدَّثَنِي مُوسَى بْنُ سَلَمَةَ الْهُذَلِيُّ، قَالَ انْطَلَقْتُ أَنَا وَسِنَانُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، مُعْتَمِرَيْنِ قَالَ وَانْطَلَقَ سِنَانٌ مَعَهُ بِبَدَنَةٍ يَسُوقُهَا فَأَزْحَفَتْ عَلَيْهِ بِالطَّرِيقِ فَعَيِيَ بِشَأْنِهَا إِنْ هِيَ أُبْدِعَتْ كَيْفَ يَأْتِي بِهَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَئِنْ قَدِمْتُ الْبَلَدَ لأَسْتَحْفِيَنَّ عَنْ ذَلِكَ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَضْحَيْتُ فَلَمَّا نَزَلْنَا الْبَطْحَاءَ قَالَ انْطَلِقْ إِلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ نَتَحَدَّثْ إِلَيْهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَذَكَرَ لَهُ شَأْنَ بَدَنَتِهِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عَلَى الْخَبِيرِ سَقَطْتَ بَعَثَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِسِتَّ عَشْرَةَ بَدَنَةً مَعَ رَجُلٍ وَأَمَّرَهُ فِيهَا - قَالَ - فَمَضَى ثُمَّ رَجَعَ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ كَيْفَ أَصْنَعُ بِمَا أُبْدِعَ عَلَىَّ مِنْهَا قَالَ ‏"‏ انْحَرْهَا ثُمَّ اصْبُغْ نَعْلَيْهَا فِي دَمِهَا ثُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ عَلَى صَفْحَتِهَا وَلاَ تَأْكُلْ مِنْهَا أَنْتَ وَلاَ أَحَدٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ رُفْقَتِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us. Abd al-Warith ibn Sa'id informed us, from Abu al-Tayyah al-Dubai. Musa ibn Salamah al-Hudhali narrated to me. He said: I and Sinan ibn Salamah set out intending to perform Umrah. Sinan went with a sacrificial camel that he was leading, but it became exhausted on the road, and he did not know what to do if it could go no farther. He said: If I reach the town, I will seek a ruling about this. When morning came and we reached al-Batha, he said: Let us go to Ibn Abbas and speak with him. He told him about his camel. Ibn Abbas said: You have asked the one who knows. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) sent sixteen sacrificial camels with a man and put him in charge of them. He went, then returned and said: Messenger of Allah, what should I do with those among them that become unable to continue? He said: Slaughter it, dye its sandals in its blood, mark its side with them, and neither you nor anyone in your company may eat from it.

Er sagte: I and Sinan ibn Salamah set out intending to perform Umra. Sinan went with a Opferkamel that he was leading, but it became exhausted on the road, and he did not know what to do if it could go no farther. Er sagte: If I reach the town, I will seek a ruling about this. When morning came and we reached al-Batha, he said: Let us go to Ibn Abbas and speak with him. He told him about his Kamel. Ibn Abbas said: You have asked the one who knows. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) sent sixteen Opferkamels with a man and put him in charge of them. He went, then returned and said: Messenger of Allah, what should I do with those among them that become unable to continue? Er sagte: Slaughter it, dye its sandals in its blood, mark its side with them, and neither you nor anyone in your company may eat from it. title: باب مَا يُفْعَلُ بِالْهَدْىِ إِذَا عَطِبَ فِي الطَّرِيقِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، عَنْ أَبِي التَّيَّاحِ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ سَلَمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعَثَ بِثَمَانَ عَشْرَةَ بَدَنَةً مَعَ رَجُلٍ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ عَبْدِ الْوَارِثِ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ أَوَّلَ الْحَدِيثِ ‏.‏
translation_en: Yahya ibn Yahya, Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, and Ali ibn Hujr narrated it to us. Yahya said: Ismail ibn Ulayyah informed us, and the other two said: He narrated to us, from Abu al-Tayyah, from Musa ibn Salamah, from Ibn Abbas, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) sent eighteen sacrificial camels with a man. Then he mentioned the same as the hadith of Abd al-Warith, without mentioning the beginning of the hadith.
translation_de: Yahya ibn Yahya, Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, and Ali ibn Hujr narrated it to us. Yahya said: Ismail ibn Ulayyah berichtete uns, and the other two said: He überlieferte uns, from Abu al-Tayyah, from Musa ibn Salamah, from Ibn Abbas, that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) sent eighteen Opferkamels with a man. Then he mentioned the same as the hadith of Abd al-Warith, without mentioning the beginning of the hadith. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

title: باب مَا يُفْعَلُ بِالْهَدْىِ إِذَا عَطِبَ فِي الطَّرِيقِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو غَسَّانَ الْمِسْمَعِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ سِنَانِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ ذُؤَيْبًا أَبَا قَبِيصَةَ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَبْعَثُ مَعَهُ بِالْبُدْنِ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ إِنْ عَطِبَ مِنْهَا شَىْءٌ فَخَشِيتَ عَلَيْهِ مَوْتًا فَانْحَرْهَا ثُمَّ اغْمِسْ نَعْلَهَا فِي دَمِهَا ثُمَّ اضْرِبْ بِهِ صَفْحَتَهَا وَلاَ تَطْعَمْهَا أَنْتَ وَلاَ أَحَدٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ رُفْقَتِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Abu Ghassan al-Misma'i narrated to me. Abd al-Ala narrated to us. Sa'id narrated to us, from Qatadah, from Sinan ibn Salamah, from Ibn Abbas, that Dhuwayb, Abu Qabisah, told him that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) used to send sacrificial camels with him and say: If one of them becomes ill and you fear it will die, slaughter it, dip its sandal in its blood, strike its side with it, and neither you nor anyone in your company may eat from it.
translation_de: Abu Ghassan al-Misma'i überlieferte mir. Abd al-Ala überlieferte uns. Sa'id überlieferte uns, from Qatadah, from Sinan ibn Salamah, from Ibn Abbas, that Dhuwayb, Abu Qabisah, told him that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) used to send Opferkamels with him and say: If one of them becomes ill and you fear it will die, slaughter it, dip its sandal in its blood, strike its side with it, and neither you nor anyone in your company may eat from it. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1327, book 15, باب وُجُوبِ طَوَافِ الْوَدَاعِ وَسُقُوطِهِ عَنِ الْحَائِضِ
title: باب وُجُوبِ طَوَافِ الْوَدَاعِ وَسُقُوطِهِ عَنِ الْحَائِضِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ الأَحْوَلِ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ كَانَ النَّاسُ يَنْصَرِفُونَ فِي كُلِّ وَجْهٍ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ يَنْفِرَنَّ أَحَدٌ حَتَّى يَكُونَ آخِرُ عَهْدِهِ بِالْبَيْتِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ زُهَيْرٌ يَنْصَرِفُونَ كُلَّ وَجْهٍ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَقُلْ فِي ‏.‏
translation_en: Sa'id ibn Mansur and Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to us. They said: Sufyan narrated to us, from Sulayman al-Ahwal, from Tawus, from Ibn Abbas, who said: People used to leave in every direction, so the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: No one should depart until his final contact is with the House. Zuhayr said: They used to leave in every direction, and he did not say 'in'.
translation_de: Sa'id ibn Mansur and Zuhayr ibn Harb überlieferte uns. They said: Sufyan überlieferte uns, from Sulayman al-Ahwal, from Tawus, from Ibn Abbas, who said: People used to leave in every direction, so der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) said: No one should depart until his final contact is with the Haus. Zuhayr said: They used to leave in every direction, and he did not say 'in'. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

title: باب وُجُوبِ طَوَافِ الْوَدَاعِ وَسُقُوطِهِ عَنِ الْحَائِضِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ - وَاللَّفْظُ لِسَعِيدٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ أُمِرَ النَّاسُ أَنْ يَكُونَ، آخِرُ عَهْدِهِمْ بِالْبَيْتِ إِلاَّ أَنَّهُ خُفِّفَ عَنِ الْمَرْأَةِ الْحَائِضِ ‏.‏
translation_en: Sa'id ibn Mansur and Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us, and Sa'id's wording is used. They said: Sufyan narrated to us, from Ibn Tawus, from his father, from Ibn Abbas, who said: The people were commanded to make their last contact with the House, except that the menstruating woman was excused from this.
translation_de: Sa'id ibn Mansur and Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah überlieferte uns, and Sa'id's wording is used. They said: Sufyan überlieferte uns, from Ibn Tawus, from his father, from Ibn Abbas, who said: The people were commanded to make their last contact with the Haus, except that the menstruating woman was excused from this. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1328 b, book 15, باب وُجُوبِ طَوَافِ الْوَدَاعِ وَسُقُوطِهِ عَنِ الْحَائِضِ
title: باب وُجُوبِ طَوَافِ الْوَدَاعِ وَسُقُوطِهِ عَنِ الْحَائِضِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي الْحَسَنُ، بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، قَالَ كُنْتُ مَعَ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ إِذْ قَالَ زَيْدُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ تُفْتِي أَنْ تَصْدُرَ الْحَائِضُ، قَبْلَ أَنْ يَكُونَ آخِرُ عَهْدِهَا بِالْبَيْتِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ إِمَّا لاَ فَسَلْ فُلاَنَةَ الأَنْصَارِيَّةَ هَلْ أَمَرَهَا بِذَلِكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ فَرَجَعَ زَيْدُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ إِلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ يَضْحَكُ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ مَا أَرَاكَ إِلاَّ قَدْ صَدَقْتَ ‏.‏
translation_en: Muhammad ibn Hatim narrated to me. Yahya ibn Sa'id narrated to us, from Ibn Jurayj. Al-Hasan ibn Muslim informed me, from Tawus. He said: I was with Ibn Abbas when Zayd ibn Thabit said: You give the ruling that the menstruating woman may depart before her last contact is with the House. Ibn Abbas said to him: If not, ask so-and-so, the Ansari woman, whether the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) commanded her to do that. Zayd ibn Thabit returned to Ibn Abbas laughing and saying: I see that you were truthful.
translation_de: Muhammad ibn Hatim überlieferte mir. Yahya ibn Sa'id überlieferte uns, from Ibn Jurayj. Al-Hasan ibn Muslim berichtete mir, from Tawus. Er sagte: I was with Ibn Abbas when Zayd ibn Thabit said: You give the ruling that the menstruating woman may depart before her last contact is with the Haus. Ibn Abbas said to him: If not, ask so-and-so, the Ansari woman, whether der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) commanded her to do that. Zayd ibn Thabit returned to Ibn Abbas laughing and saying: I see that you were truthful. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1329 a, book 15, باب اسْتِحْبَابِ دُخُولِ الْكَعْبَةِ لِلْحَاجِّ وَغَيْرِهِ وَالصَّلاَةِ فِيهَا وَالدُّعَاءِ فِي نَوَاحِيهَا كُلِّهَا
title: باب اسْتِحْبَابِ دُخُولِ الْكَعْبَةِ لِلْحَاجِّ وَغَيْرِهِ وَالصَّلاَةِ فِيهَا وَالدُّعَاءِ فِي نَوَاحِيهَا كُلِّهَا
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم دَخَلَ الْكَعْبَةَ هُوَ وَأُسَامَةُ وَبِلاَلٌ وَعُثْمَانُ بْنُ طَلْحَةَ الْحَجَبِيُّ فَأَغْلَقَهَا عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ مَكَثَ فِيهَا ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ فَسَأَلْتُ بِلاَلاً حِينَ خَرَجَ مَا صَنَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ جَعَلَ عَمُودَيْنِ عَنْ يَسَارِهِ وَعَمُودًا عَنْ يَمِينِهِ وَثَلاَثَةَ أَعْمِدَةٍ وَرَاءَهُ - وَكَانَ الْبَيْتُ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَلَى سِتَّةِ أَعْمِدَةٍ - ثُمَّ صَلَّى ‏.‏
translation_en: Yahya ibn Yahya al-Tamimi narrated to us. He said: I read to Malik, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him), Usamah, Bilal, and Uthman ibn Talhah al-Hajabi entered the Ka'bah. He closed it upon them, and they stayed inside. Ibn Umar said: When Bilal came out, I asked him what the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) had done. He said: He placed two pillars to his left, one pillar to his right, and three pillars behind him. At that time the House had six pillars. Then he prayed.
translation_de: Yahya ibn Yahya al-Tamimi überlieferte uns. Er sagte: I read to Malik, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar, that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm), Usamah, Bilal, and Uthman ibn Talhah al-Hajabi entered the Ka'bah. He closed it upon them, and they stayed inside. Ibn Umar said: When Bilal came out, I asked him what der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) had done. Er sagte: He placed two pillars to his left, one pillar to his right, and three pillars behind him. At that time the Haus had six pillars. Then he betete. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1329 b, book 15, باب اسْتِحْبَابِ دُخُولِ الْكَعْبَةِ لِلْحَاجِّ وَغَيْرِهِ وَالصَّلاَةِ فِيهَا وَالدُّعَاءِ فِي نَوَاحِيهَا كُلِّهَا
title: باب اسْتِحْبَابِ دُخُولِ الْكَعْبَةِ لِلْحَاجِّ وَغَيْرِهِ وَالصَّلاَةِ فِيهَا وَالدُّعَاءِ فِي نَوَاحِيهَا كُلِّهَا
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الزَّهْرَانِيُّ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَأَبُو كَامِلٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، - قَالَ أَبُو كَامِلٍ - حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَدِمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ الْفَتْحِ فَنَزَلَ بِفِنَاءِ الْكَعْبَةِ وَأَرْسَلَ إِلَى عُثْمَانَ بْنِ طَلْحَةَ فَجَاءَ بِالْمِفْتَحِ فَفَتَحَ الْبَابَ - قَالَ - ثُمَّ دَخَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَبِلاَلٌ وَأُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ وَعُثْمَانُ بْنُ طَلْحَةَ وَأَمَرَ بِالْبَابِ فَأُغْلِقَ فَلَبِثُوا فِيهِ مَلِيًّا ثُمَّ فَتَحَ الْبَابَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ فَبَادَرْتُ النَّاسَ فَتَلَقَّيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَارِجًا وَبِلاَلٌ عَلَى إِثْرِهِ فَقُلْتُ لِبِلاَلٍ هَلْ صَلَّى فِيهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ أَيْنَ قَالَ بَيْنَ الْعَمُودَيْنِ تِلْقَاءَ وَجْهِهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَنَسِيتُ أَنْ أَسْأَلَهُ كَمْ صَلَّى.
translation_en: Abu al-Rabi al-Zahrani, Qutaybah ibn Sa'id, and Abu Kamil al-Jahdari all narrated from Hammad ibn Zayd. Abu Kamil said: Hammad narrated to us. Ayyub narrated to us, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar, who said: On the day of the conquest, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) arrived and stopped in the courtyard of the Ka'bah. He sent for Uthman ibn Talhah, who brought the key and opened the door. The Prophet (peace be upon him), Bilal, Usamah ibn Zayd, and Uthman ibn Talhah entered, and he ordered that the door be closed. They remained inside for a while, then the door was opened. Abd Allah said: I hurried ahead of the people and met the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) as he came out, with Bilal following him. I asked Bilal whether the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) had prayed inside. He said: Yes. I asked: Where? He said: Between the two pillars facing him. I forgot to ask him how many units he prayed.
translation_de: Abu al-Rabi al-Zahrani, Qutaybah ibn Sa'id, and Abu Kamil al-Jahdari all narrated from Hammad ibn Zayd. Abu Kamil said: Hammad überlieferte uns. Ayyub überlieferte uns, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar, who said: On the day of the conquest, der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) arrived and stopped in the courtyard of the Ka'bah. He sent for Uthman ibn Talhah, who brought the key and opened the door. The Prophet (peace be upon him), Bilal, Usamah ibn Zayd, and Uthman ibn Talhah entered, and he ordered that the door be closed. They remained inside for a while, then the door was opened. Abd Allah said: I hurried ahead of the people and met der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) as he came out, with Bilal following him. I asked Bilal whether der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) had betete inside. Er sagte: Yes. I asked: Where? Er sagte: Between the two pillars facing him. I forgot to ask him how many units he betete. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1329 c, book 15, باب اسْتِحْبَابِ دُخُولِ الْكَعْبَةِ لِلْحَاجِّ وَغَيْرِهِ وَالصَّلاَةِ فِيهَا وَالدُّعَاءِ فِي نَوَاحِيهَا كُلِّهَا
title: باب اسْتِحْبَابِ دُخُولِ الْكَعْبَةِ لِلْحَاجِّ وَغَيْرِهِ وَالصَّلاَةِ فِيهَا وَالدُّعَاءِ فِي نَوَاحِيهَا كُلِّهَا
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ السَّخْتِيَانِيِّ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ، عُمَرَ قَالَ أَقْبَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَامَ الْفَتْحِ عَلَى نَاقَةٍ لأُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ حَتَّى أَنَاخَ بِفِنَاءِ الْكَعْبَةِ ثُمَّ دَعَا عُثْمَانَ بْنَ طَلْحَةَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ ائْتِنِي بِالْمِفْتَاحِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَذَهَبَ إِلَى أُمِّهِ فَأَبَتْ أَنْ تُعْطِيَهُ فَقَالَ وَاللَّهِ لَتُعْطِينِيهِ أَوْ لَيَخْرُجَنَّ هَذَا السَّيْفُ مِنْ صُلْبِي - قَالَ - فَأَعْطَتْهُ إِيَّاهُ ‏.‏ فَجَاءَ بِهِ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَدَفَعَهُ إِلَيْهِ فَفَتَحَ الْبَابَ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ حَمَّادِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ ‏.‏
translation_en: Ibn Abi Umar narrated to us. Sufyan narrated to us, from Ayyub al-Sakhtiyani, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar, who said: In the year of the conquest, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) came riding a she-camel belonging to Usamah ibn Zayd and made it kneel in the courtyard of the Ka'bah. He called Uthman ibn Talhah and said: Bring me the key. Uthman went to his mother, but she refused to give it to him. He said: By Allah, you will give it to me, or this sword will come out from my body. She gave it to him, and he brought it to the Prophet (peace be upon him), who opened the door. Then he mentioned the same as the hadith of Hammad ibn Zayd.
translation_de: Ibn Abi Umar überlieferte uns. Sufyan überlieferte uns, from Ayyub al-Sakhtiyani, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar, who said: In the year of the conquest, der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) came riding a she-Kamel belonging to Usamah ibn Zayd and made it kneel in the courtyard of the Ka'bah. He called Uthman ibn Talhah and said: Bring me the key. Uthman went to his mother, but she refused to give it to him. Er sagte: By Allah, you will give it to me, or this sword will come out from my body. She gave it to him, and he brought it to der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm), who opened the door. Then he mentioned the same as the hadith of Hammad ibn Zayd. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.
